lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five to six vertical columns of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. The centroids are more widely spaced in the mid-flank area compared to the densely packed clusters near the head and gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like arrangement of anchor nodes across the visible lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible running along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct light-to-shadow vertical gradient from the dorsal to ventral edge of each ridge.
